title: A bunch of junk
text: Really? Save your money. Looks nothing like the box on the review. My daughter got a cheap remix box.  Just a bunch of junk that looks like from the 1 store. 5 pins, 3 bracelets, light up ring, a little plastic fanny pack, a badge, bookmark, little poster, shirt, glasses and straw cup. I'm really annoyed by the 3 bracelets and 5 pins. Just cheap filler.
label: negative
